meaning: A page that lists the questions people ask most often, with a short answer to each one.
clues: A page of questions that many people have asked, each followed by a short answer.
Websites and apps often have one under Help or Support.
It can save you a phone call, because your question may already be answered.
Its letters stand for three words. One of them is "questions."
It has three letters. The first is F and the last is Q.
assumes: A glossary lists hard words and their meanings
A manual explains how to use a product
An index lists where topics are in a book

decoys.meaning: An alphabetical list of hard words with their meanings.
A book or booklet that explains how to set up and use a product.
A list at the back of a book that shows which page each topic is on.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, it was a thick manual. The answer was on page 112, if you could find it.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Now it is one page. Tip: read the FAQ first, before you call support. Your question may be there.
